meta.prompt: Build a small checkout in three steps. Step 1, my cart: Espresso beans $24 x1, Ceramic mug $12 x2, Canvas tote $18 x1, with quantities I can change and the subtotal. Step 2, shipping: name, address, city, postcode and email, all required, with a message under a field that is empty or an email without an @. Step 3, payment summary: a choice of Standard delivery ($4, 3 to 5 working days) or Express ($12, next working day) that changes the total, subtotal plus delivery. Then a confirmation with an order number, my name, my email and the total I paid. I can go back a step without losing what I typed.
meta.text:
ChatCard "Checkout" "Step 1 of 3" icon:"shopping_bag" status:"Cart"
  state step=1
  state qty=[{"id":"beans","name":"Espresso beans","price":24,"qty":1},{"id":"mug","name":"Ceramic mug","price":12,"qty":2},{"id":"tote","name":"Canvas tote","price":18,"qty":1}]
  state name=""
  state address=""
  state city=""
  state postcode=""
  state email=""
  state delivery="standard"
  state orderNo="KB-20417"
  state subtotal=sum(qty,x=>x.price*x.qty)
  if step==1
    SectionLabel "Your cart" "3 items"
    each row in qty
      CartLine "{row.name}" "Unit ${row.price}" price:row.price qty:=row.qty -> qty=updateWhere(qty,x=>x.id==row.id,x=>with(x,"qty",result))
    Details rows:=[["Subtotal",money(subtotal,"$",2)]]
    ActionButton "Continue to shipping" primary icon:"arrow_forward" -> step=2
  if step==2
    SectionLabel "Shipping" "Step 2 of 3"
    InputField "Full name" "Jane Doe" =name
    InputField "Address" "1 Main Street" =address
    InputField "City" "Springfield" =city
    InputField "Postcode" "12345" =postcode
    InputField "Email" "you@example.com" =email error:=(email!="" && !contains(email,"@"))?"Enter a valid email":(email==""?"Email is required":"")
    Row gap:10
      ActionButton "Back" quiet -> step=1
      ActionButton "Continue" primary enabled:=name!="" && address!="" && city!="" && postcode!="" && contains(email,"@") -> step=3
  if step==3
    SectionLabel "Delivery" "Step 3 of 3"
    OptionList "Delivery method" =delivery options:["standard","express"] details:["3 to 5 working days","Next working day"] prices:["$4.00","$12.00"] -> delivery=result
    Details rows:=[["Subtotal",money(subtotal,"$",2)],["Delivery",money(delivery=="express"?12:4,"$",2)],["Total",money(subtotal+(delivery=="express"?12:4),"$",2)]]
    Row gap:10
      ActionButton "Back" quiet -> step=2
      ActionButton "Place order" primary -> step=4
  if step==4
    Receipt "Order placed" "Thanks {name}, a confirmation was sent to {email}." code:=orderNo codeLabel:"Order number" tone:good icon:"check"
    Details rows:=[["Name",name],["Email",email],["Total paid",money(subtotal+(delivery=="express"?12:4),"$",2)]]
